# iPayX MCP Server — Documentation

Connect your AI agent to real-time FX audit verdicts.

## 1. Endpoints

  * Production MCP: `https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server`
  * Documentation: `https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server/docs`

## 2. Available Tools

### audit_fx_transaction

Free tier

Score any FX transaction 1-10 with a qualitative verdict. Spread % and mid-market rate are never returned in the public response.

Input
    
    {
      "amount": 10000,
      "currency_from": "USD",
      "currency_to": "EUR",
      "bank_rate": 0.9123,
      "date": "2026-05-13"
    }

Output (opaque public response)
    
    {
      "score": 7,
      "color": "yellow",
      "verdict": "Fair FX pricing",
      "currency_pair": "USD/EUR",
      "amount": 10000,
      "date": "2026-05-13",
      "encouragement": null
    }

Rate limit: 10 audits / day per API key (free).

### full_forensic_fx_report

Paid tier ($199)

Full forensic audit including spread breakdown, projected loss, and partner routing intelligence.   * Format: `ipx_live_xxxxx` (production) or `ipx_test_xxxxx` (sandbox).
  * How to get a key: Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys.
    
    Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED_POSSIBLE_SECRET]
    Content-Type: application/json
    Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

## 4. Compatible MCP Clients

  * Claude Desktop / Claude.ai
  * ChatGPT (via OpenAI Apps SDK)
  * Microsoft Azure Foundry Agents — setup guide
  * Cursor / Continue / Cline
  * Lovable Agent

## 5. Rate Limits & SLA

  * Free tier: 10 audits / day per API key.
  * Paid tier ($199): unlimited audits, priority routing.
  * SLA: 99.5% uptime, response time < 2s p95.
  * Live status: /status.

# iPayX Protocol — Neutral FX Verification Layer

iPayX Protocol is the neutral FX verification layer for fintech sales teams and FX brokers. We audit foreign-exchange transactions, compare the rate a bank or card network applied against the real-time mid-market rate, reveal invisible spreads, quantify FX costs, and project annual savings.

## How It Works

  1. Enter your transaction – Amount, currencies (e.g. CAD → USD), and the rate your bank applied.
  2. We capture the mid-market rate – From regulated interbank data sources at the exact transaction time.
  3. Instant audit report – Spread %, FX cost in your base currency, execution grade (A/B/C), and annual savings projection.

## Trust & Compliance

MSB FINTRAC C10001283 | 0-custody | AES-256 | Built in Canada 🇨🇦

# Logging In

To use the iPay API, you need a merchant account.

Account creation is handled by the iPay team. Contact support via i-pay.io to initiate the process. Accounts are opened after a simple KYB (website, incorporation documents, directors/shareholders/UBO), reviewed by the iPay team within 24 hours.

Once your account is approved, log in to the dashboard:

  1. Visit dash.i-pay.io and click “Forgot password”.
  2. Follow the emailed link to set a new password.
  3. Log in with your credentials.

After logging in, use the dashboard for initial setup:

  * Company Registration: Enter your business details.
  * Account Setup: Connect your crypto wallet.
  * API Key Creation: Generate a key with your callback URL, then have the iPay team activate it and register your redirect URL.

note

Keep credentials secure and share dashboard access only with trusted team members.

# iPayX Protocol — API Terms of Service

Version 0.1 (Draft)

Last updated: 2026-09-22

## 1. Definitions

"iPayX" refers to iPayX Protocol, operated by 11850091 Canada Inc. "API Client" means any entity that has been issued an API key (prefixed `ipx_live_`) to access the iPayX Audit API. "Client Data" means the raw transaction data submitted to the API. "Aggregated Data" means anonymized, statistical data derived from multiple API Clients.

## 2. License & API Access

Subject to these Terms and timely payment of fees, iPayX grants the API Client a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access the API solely for the API Client's internal business purposes and for providing audit results to its own end customers.

## 3. Acceptable Use

API Clients agree not to:

  * Reverse-engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract the iPayX scoring algorithm.
  * Submit fraudulent, fabricated, or illegally obtained transaction data.
